name: BabySwap
fix_description: In _swap, validate that the factory parameter is the legitimate BabySwap factory address (whitelist check). Reject any swap call with an unrecognized factory to prevent fake swaps from earning mining rewards.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is a short, direct reward-farming abuse: deploy a fake factory/pair, perform two crafted swaps through the router so swap mining credits rewards, then withdraw and dump the reward token. It relies on an obvious trust issue in external pair/factory validation and needs only a few calls with minimal protocol complexity.
